verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp vwọ kpare opharo, nighe, Isọ ra yan cha, ọ vẹ ihwo uri ivẹ ri nene. Etiyin ọ da ghare emọ na kẹ Leah vi Rachel kugbe emetẹ rayen ivẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: jekop vwo kpare opharo nighe iso ra yan cha o ve ihwo uri ive ri nene etiyin o da ghare emo na ke leah vi rachel kugbe emete rayen ive na

verses.text_urhobo: O de phi eyaobọ na vẹ emọ rayen phihọ obaro, Leah vẹ emọ rọye da vwọ kpahe ayen, Rachel vi Josẹf da ka obuko.
verses.text_romanized: o de phi eyaobo na ve emo rayen phiho obaro leah ve emo roye da vwo kpahe ayen rachel vi josef da ka obuko

verses.text_urhobo: Okpuyovwi rọye da ka obaro kẹ ayen, o de diguẹ vwẹ uyovwi te otọ asieghwrẹ, bẹsiẹ o rhi vwo te asan rẹ oniọvo rọye epha.
verses.text_romanized: okpuyovwi roye da ka obaro ke ayen o de digue vwe uyovwi te oto asieghwre besie o rhi vwo te asan re oniovo roye epha

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Isọ da djẹ ra vwa, ọ da gbanọ, ọ da vwẹ uyovwi kpahọ ohọre ọ da fiọnfiọn unu, ayen da viẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo iso da dje ra vwa o da gbano o da vwe uyovwi kpaho ohore o da fionfion unu ayen da vie

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Isọ vwọ kparo mrẹ eya vẹ emọ, ọ da ta, Ena amono ri nene uwe na? Jekọp da ta, Emọ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwo ru ẹse kẹ odibo wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: oke re iso vwo kparo mre eya ve emo o da ta ena amono ri nene uwe na jekop da ta emo re oghene vwo ru ese ke odibo wen

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin eyaobọ na de si kerẹ, te ayen te emọ rayen, ayen de diguẹ kẹ,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin eyaobo na de si kere te ayen te emo rayen ayen de digue ke

verses.text_urhobo: Leah vẹ emọ rọye de si kẹrẹ ayen de diguẹ, ukuko rọye Josẹf vi Rachel de si kẹrẹ, ayen de diguẹ.
verses.text_romanized: leah ve emo roye de si kere ayen de digue ukuko roye josef vi rachel de si kere ayen de digue

verses.text_urhobo: Isọ da ta, Kidie a vwẹ usun nana ejobi na re Me vware na vwo ru? Jekọp da kpahe, Re Me vwọ mrẹ aroesiri vwẹ obaro rẹ ọrovwovwe.
verses.text_romanized: iso da ta kidie a vwe usun nana ejobi na re me vware na vwo ru jekop da kpahe re me vwo mre aroesiri vwe obaro re orovwovwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Isọ da ta, Mi vwori buebu, oniọvo mẹ, sẹro rayen vwọ kẹ oma wẹn.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo iso da ta mi vwori buebu oniovo me sero rayen vwo ke oma wen

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp da ta, Ẹjo, Me rẹ wẹ, ọ da dianẹ ivun mẹ vwerhe owẹ, gba reyọ ọghọ na mie vwe, vwẹ uyota a da mrẹ opharo wẹn, kọ họhọ ohwo rọ mrẹ opharo rẹ Ọghẹnẹ, gba vwẹ ẹguọnọ ro jẹrhẹriẹ tiọye na reyọ ovwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: jekop da ta ejo me re we o da diane ivun me vwerhe owe gba reyo ogho na mie vwe vwe uyota a da mre opharo wen ko hoho ohwo ro mre opharo re oghene gba vwe eguono ro jerherie tioye na reyo ovwe

verses.text_urhobo: Reyọ, Me rẹ wẹ, ọko nana re Me phare rhe we na, kidie Ọghẹnẹ ru ẹse kẹ vwẹ gangan, fikiridie ọ ri mi vwori na te kẹ vwẹ. Ọtiọna kọye ọ rẹrẹ, ọ da reyọ.
verses.text_romanized: reyo me re we oko nana re me phare rhe we na kidie oghene ru ese ke vwe gangan fikiridie o ri mi vwori na te ke vwe otiona koye o rere o da reyo

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Isọ da ta, Gbe jẹ a yanran, ke Me ka obaro kẹ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin iso da ta gbe je a yanran ke me ka obaro ke we

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Jekọp da ta, kẹ, Ọrovwovwe riẹnre nẹ emọ na pha mwẹmwẹ, kugbe uchuru na ri vievie na e ro vwẹ ẹwan, a da djẹ ayen kpata kpata nọ ẹdẹ ọvo, uchuru na ejobi ki ghwu.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo jekop da ta ke orovwovwe rienre ne emo na pha mwemwe kugbe uchuru na ri vievie na e ro vwe ewan a da dje ayen kpata kpata no ede ovo uchuru na ejobi ki ghwu

verses.text_urhobo: Jẹn ọrovwovwe ka obaro kẹ odibo rọye, rere Me jomaotọ sun ayen rhe, rere Me tẹtẹ ayen rhe kirobo rẹ uchuru na sa yan te, kirobo rẹ emọ na sa yan te, bẹsiẹ Me cha vwọ yan mu ọrovwovwe vwẹ obi Seir.
verses.text_romanized: jen orovwovwe ka obaro ke odibo roye rere me jomaoto sun ayen rhe rere me tete ayen rhe kirobo re uchuru na sa yan te kirobo re emo na sa yan te besie me cha vwo yan mu orovwovwe vwe obi seir

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Isọ da ta, Gbe ju vwe yan jẹn ihwo mẹ ẹvo vwo kẹ wẹ. Ẹkẹvuọvo ọ da ta, Kidie Me vwẹ ayen ru? Ju vwe mrẹ ivuavwerhe vwẹ obaro rẹ ọrovwovwe.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin iso da ta gbe ju vwe yan jen ihwo me evo vwo ke we ekevuovo o da ta kidie me vwe ayen ru ju vwe mre ivuavwerhe vwe obaro re orovwovwe

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Isọ de rhivwi ẹdẹ yena kpo obi Seir.
verses.text_romanized: koye iso de rhivwi ede yena kpo obi seir

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Jekọp de mu oyan vwo kpo Sukọt, ọ da bọn uwevwi kẹ oma rọye, ọ da rha bọn itughẹ kẹ uchuru rọye; fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se odẹ rẹ asan na Sukọt.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo jekop de mu oyan vwo kpo sukot o da bon uwevwi ke oma roye o da rha bon itughe ke uchuru roye fiki re otioye na e de se ode re asan na sukot

verses.text_urhobo: Jekọp de rhi te orere ri Shikẹm gberhẹnẹdẹ, rọ otọ ri Kenan, vwẹ idjerhe ra wan ni Padanaram cha, o de mu erhọn phihọ ughere rẹ orere na.
verses.text_romanized: jekop de rhi te orere ri shikem gberhenede ro oto ri kenan vwe idjerhe ra wan ni padanaram cha o de mu erhon phiho ughere re orere na

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ obọ rẹ emọ ri Hamọr, ọsẹ ri Shikẹm, ọ da dẹ otọ na ebo rẹ igho ujori kẹ Etiyin ọ bọn utughẹ rọye phihọ.
verses.text_romanized: vwe obo re emo ri hamor ose ri shikem o da de oto na ebo re igho ujori ke etiyin o bon utughe roye phiho

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da so agbada phihọ Etiyin o de se odẹ rọye El-Elohe Izrẹl.
verses.text_romanized: o da so agbada phiho etiyin o de se ode roye el elohe izrel
